{{Quote|''Yellowblade's Landing'' is hardly a tourist destination.|[[Nukss]], to Darth Maul and Savage Opress|<ref name="TSH" />}}
'''Yellowblade's Landing''' was a settlement on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="FF23">{{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}}</ref> [[Orto Norwe]]<ref name="Email" /> which was controlled by the criminal gang known as [[the Scourge]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brothers [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] landed on the world and slaughtered all residents of Yellowblade's Landing to prevent them from revealing their presence to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TSH" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[March]] [[2023]] that Yellowblade's Landing was a location on Orto Norwe.<ref name="Email" />
